PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data scientist with experience developing forecasting and churn models, experimentation tools, and scheduled data workflows. CORE SKILLS
Machine learning: LightGBM, XGBoost, feature engineering, customer churn propensity, demand forecasting, SHAP

Data and workflow: BigQuery, dbt, Vertex AI Workbench scheduled notebooks, Looker
Engineering practices: pytest unit testing, Dockerfile authoring, Streamlit
Statistics: Sequential A/B testing, Bayesian hierarchical models, experimental design

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Data Scientist | Thistlebox | 2022–Present

- Built a Streamlit calculator for planning and analysing sequential A/B tests; used by about 25 people in product and growth. Wrote its Dockerfile; the data platform team handles deployment to Cloud Run.
- Started writing pytest unit tests for forecasting feature code in 2025; coverage is about 60%.
- Delivered internal “Stats for PMs” training three times.

Junior Data Analyst | Firth Energy Retail | 2020–2022
- Segmented customers and analysed tariffs using R and SQL.
- Automated monthly regulator reports with R Markdown, saving the team about two days each month.

EDUCATION
MSc in Statistics
Dissertation: Bayesian hierarchical models

ADDITIONAL PROJECT
Image classification course project | 2025
- Fine-tuned a small CNN in PyTorch on a public food images dataset as part of an online deep learning course; achieved about 80% accuracy. Learning project only.
- Tools: PyTorch, torchvision, Google Colab.

Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN]

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Machine Learning Engineer – Customer Support AI role at Quillstone Payments. In my data science work, I have built and evaluated forecasting and churn models and developed an experimentation tool, using Python and BigQuery to support operational and product decisions.

At Thistlebox, I developed a weekly recipe-demand forecast that reduced WAPE from 23% to 14%, with an estimated 9% reduction in food waste. I also built a weekly batch-scored churn model used to target retention offers; a 10% holdout validation showed churn down 2.1 percentage points in the treated group. These projects have given me practical experience with feature engineering, model evaluation, and scheduled data workflows.

I have also built a Streamlit calculator for sequential A/B testing, used by about 25 people in product and growth. I wrote its Dockerfile, while the data platform team manages deployment to Cloud Run. In 2025, I began adding pytest unit tests to forecasting feature code, reaching about 60% coverage. My MSc in Statistics, including a dissertation on Bayesian hierarchical models, underpins my approach to modelling and uncertainty.

Quillstone’s AI team focuses on helping merchants get answers quickly and supporting customer operations through models and assistants. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my modelling and analytical experience to that work while developing further in production machine learning engineering. Thank you for considering my application; I would be glad to discuss my experience and fit for the role.

Kind regards,
Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
